text: Professional positioning and training objectivesThe major of Network and New Media is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates communication studies, computer science, digital content creation and data analysis, focusing on the innovative forms and technological applications of information dissemination in the Internet environment. The core lies in solving the problems of information dissemination, brand building and user connection in the new media era through the compound capabilities of "content production + technology empowerment + platform operation".Core training objectives:Master the full-process skills of new media content planning, multimedia production and platform operation, and possess practical abilities from topic selection to communication effect analysis.Understand the logic of Internet technology and the characteristics of user behavior, and be able to complete digital communication projects by combining tools such as big data and artificial intelligence;Cultivate cross-media thinking and innovative consciousness, and become a compound new media talent with both content creativity, technology application and operation management capabilities.
